profile.headline: Software Engineer at Intel Corporation
profile.summary: Specialties: Algorithms and Data Structures, Software Engineering, Evolutionary Computation

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Teaching Assistant for Computer Architecture.
• Help students with digital logic and major components of computer systems.
• Evaluate homework assignments and submit grades to students.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Test software quality, including testing, implementation, debugging, using test instances to maximize the functional and conditional code coverage of the system.

positions.title: Senior Project
positions.description:
• Added functions in multiple platforms: Avida, Avida to robots project, and webots.
• Used Artificial Intelligence to evolve navigational behavior on digital organisms
• Tested results on an e-puck robot using webots.

positions.title: Avida Translator research project
positions.description:
• Translated evolved Avida digital organisms to Lego Mindstorms NXT 2.0, and e-puck. 
• 3rd place poster award during the Hispanic Engineering, Science, and Technology week.

positions.title: Mentor for the Computer Science & Engineering Mentoring Program
positions.description:
• Planned and organized meetings regarding university resources.
• Assisted entering freshmen students in completing their academic study successfully.
• Helped students to better understand basic computer science concepts.

positions.title: Lab Consultant
positions.description:
• Assisted students to work with assembly language, C++ lab assignments.
• Provided constant maintenance to all the computers in the computer science lab.

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.locationName: College of Arts & Humanities - Dean's Office
positions.description:
• Manage and organize degree plans and applications for  
graduation for the College of Arts & Humanities.
• Send and deliver information to the departments of History & Philosophy, English, Communications, Music, and Modern Languages.
